component.name: OpenGlad
component.summary: Top-down gauntlet-style action RPG with online multiplayer

description.p: OpenGlad is a port of the open-sourced DOS game known as Gladiator, a top-view gauntlet-style RPG that features fast-paced multiplayer action, several different classes, and a scenario editor. This port adds networked multiplayer, five additional campaigns, seven versus modes, and a modding API in Lua.

ul.li: Seven campaigns, including the original Gladiator and The Tryxian Chronicles
Seven versus modes across 40 arenas: Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Onslaught, Soccer, Basketball, Mutant and Free-for-All
Up to four players on one screen, and up to sixteen seats in an online lobby
Online multiplayer rooms hosted through a public relay, with no port forwarding required
A built-in scenario editor (Openscen) and a Lua modding API for classes, weapons and campaigns
Split-screen, online and bot-driven play, with joystick support

description.p: As of July 1st, 2002, the original Gladiator was open sourced under the GPL by the Forgotten Sages Development Team.
